name: Input
summary: Single-line text input. The base of every text-entry form control. Renders inside a Field shell that owns the focus surface.

mono.description: Render value with tabular numerics + slashed-zero (Satoshi tnum). Use for IDs, ZIPs, codes, weights, money. v0.10 — `mono` no longer switches typeface; the family stays Satoshi and the flag toggles the OpenType feature stack (tnum, lnum, zero) that puts characters on a tabular grid.

readOnly.description: Non-editable but focusable, copyable, and in tab order. Distinct from disabled.

placeholder.description: Hint, not a substitute for a label.

inputMode.description: Hints the on-screen keyboard. Set per type for mobile UX.

autoComplete.description: Always set for known input types — name, email, current-password, postal-code, etc.

keyboard: Tab — move focus to next control
Shift+Tab — move focus to previous control
rules: Always paired with a visible label via Field, or with aria-label if visually-hidden.
Errors announced via aria-describedby pointing to a helper element with role=alert.
Required marked via aria-required=true AND a visual indicator (asterisk or `(optional)` siblings).
Validation fires on blur after first interaction; switches to onChange after first error; submits validate everything and focus the first invalid field.
Submit failure moves focus to the first invalid field via element.focus({ preventScroll: false }).
Placeholder is never the only label.
aria-describedby carries BOTH hint and error IDs (space-separated) so AT users hear both.

do: Always pair with a visible label.
Use mono for IDs, ZIPs, codes, weights, money — anything that benefits from character alignment.
Set inputMode and autoComplete for known input types.
Use type=email/tel/url to populate the right mobile keyboard.
Compose in a Field for label + helper + error orchestration.
dont: Don't use placeholder as the only label.
Don't validate on every keystroke before first interaction.
Don't paint a focus ring on the inner <input> when it's wrapped in a Field — the Field owns the ring.

changelog.note: Adopts the .lumen-field shell. Inner <input> renders bare; the wrapper paints the single focus ring. Removes text-base md:text-sm font-size override that fought Lumen's 14 px body floor. Adds readOnly distinct from disabled, autofill recipe, success/warning border tokens.

`mono` prop no longer switches typeface — the family stays Satoshi and the flag toggles the OpenType feature stack (tabular-nums, lining-nums, slashed-zero) for column alignment. v0.10 retired JetBrains Mono system-wide.
